name: Blue Yonder
tagline: Blue Yonder (now part of Panasonic) is an AI-driven supply chain platform that covers demand forecasting, inventory optimisation, transportation management, and warehouse automation. Its machine-learning models analyse thousands of variables to help retailers and manufacturers reduce stock-outs, cut carrying costs, and improve on-time delivery. Customers include major global retailers and CPG companies.
